CREATE_PROJECT_INFO:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_info (
            uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            dcim_path TEXT NOT NULL,
            dcim_linked INTEGER NOT NULL,
            version_major INTEGER NOT NULL,
            version_mid INTEGER NOT NULL,
            version_minor INTEGER NOT NULL
        );
CREATE_VIDEOS:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS videos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            dualFisheye INTEGER,
            dualFisheyeLow INTEGER,
            equirectangular INTEGER,
            equirectangularLow INTEGER
        );
CREATE_SEGMENTS:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS segments (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            video INTEGER NOT NULL,
            dualFisheye INTEGER,
            dualFisheyeLow INTEGER,
            FOREIGN KEY(video) REFERENCES videos(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
        );
UPDATE_PROJECT_INFO:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO project_info
            (uuid, name, dcim_path, dcim_linked, version_major, version_mid, version_minor)
        VALUES
            (:uuid, :name, :dcim_path, :dcim_linked, :version_major, :version_mid, :version_minor)
        ;
UPDATE_VIDEO:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO videos
            (id, dualFisheye, dualFisheyeLow, equirectangular, equirectangularLow)
        VALUES
            (:id, :dualFisheye, :dualFisheyeLow, :equirectangular, :equirectangularLow)
        ;
UPDATE_SEGMENT:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO segments
            (id, video, dualFisheye, dualFisheyeLow)
        VALUES
            (:id, :video, :dualFisheye, :dualFisheyeLow)
        ;
